pairs.why: The hats are almost the same, but A's lighter cyan sunburst background with a bright center matches the real bounce-house card better than B's darker, flatter blue.
This is the same pair as q000 with the sides swapped: B has the lighter cyan sunburst that matches the real cards, while the hat rendering is effectively identical.
The badges are nearly identical, but A's bright saturated magenta rings match the vivid concentric backgrounds of the real cards better than B's dim, muddy purple.
This is the same pair as q002 with the sides swapped: B has the bright magenta ring background that fits the real cards' saturation, while A's dark purple reads dull.

B's boots are smoother, with soft embossed tooling and evenly lit toy-like leather, closer to the real cards' clean finish; A's dotted teal stitching and darker leather add busy, texture-heavy detail.
This is the same pair as q004 with the sides swapped: A has the smoother leather and soft embossing that suit the real cards, while B's stitched pattern reads more texture-heavy.
A's bright silver, with a clean highlight and a warm rim light, matches the lively, well-lit finish of the real cards; B's bluish steel looks duller and more like matte clay.
This is the same pair as q006 with the sides swapped: B has the brighter silver and warm rim light that fit the real cards, while A's blue-grey steel looks flat and dull.
